data.name: Shilpa
data.gender_notes: Shilpa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word शिल्प (shilpa) meaning 'carving', 'sculpture', or 'craft'. In Hindu mythology, Shilpa is a name for the goddess of arts and crafts, Patron of artists and architects. This name is associated with creativity, beauty, and skill. The name Shilpa carries the meaning “Carving, Sculpture” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Shilpa usually hope their child will grow to embody carving, sculpture and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Shilpa belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Carving, Sculpture.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shilpa total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shilpa has deep cultural significance in Hinduism as it is believed to be a divine name for the goddess of arts and creativity. This name is revered by artists, craftsmen, sculptors, and architects who wish to invoke the blessings of the divine Shilpa for their artistic endeavors. Fine arts, sculpture, and crafts were held in high regard in ancient Indian society, and the name Shilpa is a reminder of the rich cultural heritage of India.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Shilpa symbolizes the potential within each of us to create beauty and art in our lives, reflecting the divine creativity inherent in all beings. The goddess Shilpa represents the power and inspiration to bring our creative visions to life, and her blessings can help us tap into our inner world of imagination and manifest our deepest desires. By wearing or using the name Shilpa, one can invoke the divine energy of creativity and be inspired to create and beautify the world around them.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shilpa signifies the creative artist within us. It represents the ability to mold and shape our thoughts, ideas, and actions just as a sculptor shapes clay. The name embodies the power of expression and the beauty of crafting one's own destiny.

vedic_reference.note: The name Shilpa is derived from the Sanskrit word शिल्प (śilpa), which means 'form, figure, or image'. In Hindu mythology, a Shilpa is also referred to as a sacred image or idol.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Shilpa was a renowned sculptor in the Gupta Empire. The name Shilpa carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
